GoDaddy Introduces Airo AI Builder to Streamline Website and App Creation

31 Oct 2026, 09:20 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Tech Desk · Source: www.techradar.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysGoDaddy has detailed its Airo AI Builder platform, a website and application construction tool designed to let users create professional, commerce-ready sites using prompt-based inputs. According to the reported details, the system aims to reduce the time required to launch an online presence from months to minutes by removing traditional coding barriers.

Building Sites with Natural Language

GoDaddy has detailed its Airo AI Builder platform, a website and application construction tool designed to let users create professional, commerce-ready sites using prompt-based inputs. According to the reported details, the system aims to reduce the time required to launch an online presence from months to minutes by removing traditional coding barriers.

The platform accepts multimodal inputs, allowing users to initiate designs via written prompts, uploaded files, URLs, or voice commands. Once a foundational site is generated, users can modify elements using natural language instructions. The software supports building various digital properties, including single pages, databases, web applications, portfolios, and online storefronts equipped with product listings, shopping carts, and checkout features.

Structure and Pricing Tiers

The service operates on a credit-based model alongside free evaluation options:

  • Free Tier: New accounts receive 50 free credits per month without requiring a credit card or subscription, allowing users to test designs, preview layouts, and set up domains.
  • Pay-As-You-Go: Additional credits can be purchased without locking into a long-term subscription.
  • Starter Plan: Includes a free domain for the first year, code ownership, and access to marketing campaigns.
  • Professional Plan: Adds analytics, collaborator options, and search engine optimization (SEO) tools.
  • Ultimate Plan: Permits publishing up to the tier limit of applications across multiple sites with bundled support.

Paid plans include payment and booking functionalities, while editing text and images directly does not consume credits.

Practical Implications and Verification

For small business owners, freelancers, or service providers looking to establish a digital footprint without technical expertise, AI-driven site builders offer an alternative to traditional development cycles. However, users should carefully evaluate ownership terms, hosting arrangements, and long-term scaling limits before committing to specific tiers.
